probe: pinned backend -> provider transformation captured from a recording mock provider, per scenario
stage1Boundary: Validates the backend to provider transformation only. Browser-side prompt assembly is not covered.

custom-source-nonstream.purpose: Custom OpenAI-compatible source using custom_url and the CUSTOM secret, non-streaming. Different URL, key and header assembly from the native source.
custom-source-nonstream.stage1Boundary: Stage 1 validates the backend -> provider transformation only. Browser-side prompt assembly happens in the frontend before the request reaches the route and is NOT covered here; a green provider-wire capture is not evidence of preset-level equivalence.

http.note: Stage 1 drives the backend directly with the browser-equivalent request; this is the driver request, not a browser capture. The mock authority is normalized to <mock> because the mock listens on an ephemeral port.
